name: dropdown-menu
description: A sketchy-bordered menu panel with hand-drawn item separators, built on Radix Dropdown Menu. Includes items, checkbox items, radio items, labels, and separators.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Draw-in the panel border when the menu opens.
Defaults to the DoodleUIProvider value (true).

props.name: bowing
props.description: How much straight lines bow/curve in rough.js.

props.name: fillStyle
props.description: Fill pattern when the shape has a fill color.

props.name: fillWeight
props.description: Weight/thickness of individual hatch lines inside patterned fills.

props.name: hachureAngle
props.description: Angle in degrees of hatch lines for patterned fills.

props.name: hachureGap
props.description: Spacing between hatch lines for patterned fills.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Sketchiness intensity passed to rough.js. Higher values look messier.

props.name: seed
props.description: Locks the hand-drawn wobble. Omit to follow SketchSeedProvider or fixed-then-randomize.

props.name: sketchColor
props.description: Stroke (outline) color override. Falls back to theme ink.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Width of sketch strokes in pixels.
